Only used when a photograph lacks EXIF focal metadata. This is an assumption, not calibration. Changing a default does not change an active scan.
Use a finite focal length from 10 to 200 mm.
Automatic resource-bounded processing. The installed engine selects compact or standard limits from available heap. Larger unqualified profiles are unavailable.
Capture, reconstruction and viewing are local. The app has no INTERNET permission, account, analytics or automatic uploads.

Originals, calibration and results stay in app-private storage. Uninstalling removes them. Export important originals and models before uninstalling. Automatic app backup and device transfer are disabled by the app’s declared rules.
Exports are sent only to the document provider you choose. That provider can have its own network, account or retention behavior. The exported files may contain private photographs.

Observed geometry can have holes, seams and arbitrary scale. Calibration does not establish real object size or unseen-surface completeness. No print-ready or real-device quality guarantee is implied.
